maya: short idea drop: entropy-buffered batching. use small randomized hold + tenant credits to avoid synchronized flushes and preserve packing.

sam: high level?

maya: callers can set optional `deadline_hint_ms`. we bucket hints. admission draws randomized hold in [0, max_extra_delay] biased by bucket. flush when batch full or hold expires.

liam: random hold may break KV affinity.

maya: we add affinity-bias: prefer grouping items with same shard unless affinity hit-rate falls. fallback to probabilistic mixing if affinity low.

ana: how to stop abuse?

maya: tenant token bucket for low-hint claims + reactive cost-based penalty.

sam: perf concerns: extra fields per-item and comparator complexity.

maya: keep footprint tiny: (tenant_id, bucket_idx, enq_ts, affinity_idx) ints only. comparator: bucket -> deadline_ts_rand -> affinity weight.

opsbot: I can run a canary once you push. :gear:

maya: plan: 1) sim harness changes + workload driver, 2) perf microbench, 3) canary on small cluster. branch `exp/entropy-batch-v1`.

l iam: add deterministic fastpath for strict SLO consumers and RBAC for who can use it.

maya: noted. will draft RFC follow-up with sim plots and rollout plan. any other risks?

runtime-ci-bot: scheduled canary job `canary-entropy-1` for 04:00 UTC tomorrow for branch `exp/entropy-batch-v1`.

maya: thanks all.
